responsibility: General Ada/GCC utility module centered on frontend-specific attributes, builtin installation, and shared global state used during gigi translation. It defines GNAT-managed standard decl and raise-function tables, implements handlers for the Ada-visible subset of GCC attributes (including diagnostics and vector attributes), reconstructs types when attributes change pointer/function/array wrappers, and installs Ada-specific plus common and target builtins by combining ada-builtins.def, builtin type tables, and targetm builtin initialization.
